sample_unit: cases (52 published case reports and 20 constructed scenarios with simulated patient interactions)
unlisted_practices: Structured agentic iterative prompting framework that evaluates relevance and completeness across history domains and generates targeted follow-up questions for patient-facing history taking

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an agentic LLM system for simulated patient history taking and clinical summary generation, evaluated by blinded physicians, but does not test a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice comparison.
